name: Shower queue
summary: One bathroom, everyone with an early class: the hallway with the line at the bathroom door and the morning as a timeline underneath, one slot per person sized by their shower. Drag your slot to move in line, tap it to change your length; in the morning 'I'm out' tells the next person they're up.
useWhen: one bathroom four roommates and we all have a 9am
will takes 25 minute showers, we need a schedule
bathroom order for the morning before the trip / the wedding / the game
line up showers so nobody's late
dontUseWhen: weekly chores like cleaning the bathroom (use chore-wheel)
finding a time to meet (use meeting-time)

sub.description: Under the title, e.g. 'One bathroom, four 9ams'

end.description: Everyone must be out by, 24-hour time like '8:45'

queue.description: The line, first to last (up to 6), with each person's minutes (5 to 30, in fives) and a line in their own words
